summary: The changelog sanity test lints fragments with antsibull-changelog and requires sections like minor_changes or bugfixes, and new modules or plugins must not be in fragments.
questions: Which sections are allowed in a changelog fragment?
Should I add a changelog fragment for a new module?

answer_card.title: changelog test
answer_card.answer_md: Fragments are linted with `antsibull-changelog lint`. Valid sections: `major_changes`, `minor_changes`, `breaking_changes`, `deprecated_features`, `removed_features`, `security_fixes`, `bugfixes`, `known_issues`. Don't add fragments for new modules or plugins.
